title: How Open Design Works
description: The culture and mechanics of contributing design in public: GitHub as a forum with files attached, comments that land, and your first public contribution act.

objectives: Understand how open-source design decisions get made without a boss: issues, proposals, rough consensus
Read a project like a designer — README, CONTRIBUTING, issue history, closed threads
Write public comments that land: evidence first, screenshots inline, questions that invite critique
Share Figma work in issues so maintainers actually engage with it

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Community — how to get involved
resources.desc: CORE. The community's own onboarding: calls calendar, project channels, and the current Discord invite. Join the Discord this week (assignment) and lurk the design channels; attend one design review call live if the time zone allows.

resources.title: Open Source Design community
resources.desc: CORE. The wider world of design in OSS beyond Bitcoin: jobs board, community, and the long-running conversation about why design struggles in open source (and what fixes it). Context that makes you a better contributor everywhere.

resources.title: GitHub's Open Source Guides — "How to Contribute"
resources.desc: SKIM. Mechanics only: what forks, PRs, and issues are in GitHub's own words. Skim for vocabulary; our GitHub for Designers doc covers the designer-relevant path.

resources.title: The annotated example threads (Contribution Playbook, Section 6)
resources.desc: CORE. 2–3 real design issue threads, annotated by facilitators: study the moves (evidence first, questions that invite, graceful redirect) rather than the specifics. Available in the Contribution Playbook.

resources.title: Bitcoin Design Community — proposal discussion call recording
resources.desc: VIDEO. Watch one call where someone brings a proposal and the community responds. This is the social reality you're entering; it is friendlier than your nerves think. Facilitator posts the current pick in #week-8.

assignment.title: Your first public contribution act
assignment.submissionFormat: Three links/screenshots (Discord intro, issue comment, Gate 4 scope draft)
